description: This file defines React components for displaying image differences, including various view modes such as diff, side-by-side, and slider, with support for loading images asynchronously and rendering comparison UI.

classes.name: ImageDiffView
classes.description: React component for displaying image differences with multiple view modes.

classes.name: ImageDiffSlider
classes.description: React component for displaying a slider view to compare expected and actual images.

classes.name: ImageWithSize
classes.description: React component for rendering an image with size info and optional click handler.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an image from a source URL and returns an HTMLImageElement.
